tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250thugs sgrub bde gshegs 'dus pa'i brgyud 'debs bzhugs so// 1$0000300chos sku mtha' yas longs sku 'jig rten mgon// sprul sku pad 'byung mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma// sangs rgyas dbon po thugs sras kun dga' dpal// o rgyan mgon po yon tan rgyal ba'i mtshan// bsod nams rgyal mtshan ye shes rgyal ba bzang*// rin bzang don grub rin chen chos dpal bzang*// bsod nams bkra shis mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang*// kun dga' bkra shis ngag dbang rnam par rgyal// bkra shis dpal grub grags pa legs grub dang*// 'jam dpal rgya mtsho 'phags mchog ngag dbang grags// phrin las bstan 'dzin grags pa rin she dang*// mthong thos dpal 'phel chos rje kun dga'i mtshan// chos dbyings lhun grub ngag dbang bstan pa'i nyi// padma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa sogs// bka' brgyud bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas// mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can srung ma la// sgo gsum rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba 'debs// dbang bzhis rgyud smin sgrib pa rnam bzhi dag /lam bzhi mthar phyin sku bzhi mngon gyur nas// bde chen padma'i zhal dang grags pa dpal// dbyer med phyag rgya'i ye shes myur 'grub shog /
ces pa'ang blo gros mtha' yas kyis sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/// /
